start_urls.title: Start URLs
start_urls.description: Paste Indeed search URLs directly. If provided, search keywords are ignored.

search_keywords.title: Search Keywords
search_keywords.description: Job titles or keywords to search for. One keyword per line.

search_location.title: Location
search_location.description: Search location (e.g. New York, NY or Remote).

search_country.title: Country Code
search_country.description: Indeed country code (us, uk, ca, au, de, fr, in, sg, nz, ie, za).

date_filter.title: Date Filter
date_filter.description: Only return jobs from the last N days. Allowed values: any, 1, 3, 7, 14.

account_cookies.title: Indeed Account Cookies
account_cookies.description: Indeed session cookies as a JSON array. Optional.

about_me.title: About Me / Target Role
about_me.description: Describe your target role so AI can score job relevance.

min_match_percentage.title: Minimum AI Match %
min_match_percentage.description: Jobs below this percentage will be skipped. Use 0 to collect all jobs.

max_jobs.title: Maximum Jobs
max_jobs.description: Maximum number of jobs to collect.

per_company_jobs.title: Maximum Jobs Per Company
per_company_jobs.description: Maximum number of jobs to collect from a single company.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of parallel workers. Recommended 25. Maximum 50.

scrape_company_details.title: Scrape Company Details
scrape_company_details.description: Collect additional information from company profile pages.

save_unique_only.title: Save Unique Jobs Only
save_unique_only.description: Prevent duplicate jobs from being saved.

skip_expired_jobs.title: Skip Expired Jobs
skip_expired_jobs.description: Ignore expired or unavailable job postings.

skip_ignore_related_jobs.title: Skip Ignore-Related Jobs
skip_ignore_related_jobs.description: Skip jobs matching the ignore-related keywords.

follow_apply_redirect.title: Resolve Apply Redirect
follow_apply_redirect.description: Resolve and store the final application URL.

ignore_companies.title: Ignore Companies
ignore_companies.description: Company names to ignore. One company per line.

ignore_related.title: Ignore Keywords
ignore_related.description: Keywords indicating unrelated jobs. One keyword per line.

processed_job_urls.title: Processed Job URLs
processed_job_urls.description: Previously processed job URLs to skip.

google_sheet_url.title: Google Sheet URL
google_sheet_url.description: Google Sheet shared with edit permission.
